anchorAudit.rationale: The existing atrium photograph separates five departments. Each point was placed on a visible object, object part, or clearly indicated room. Diseases, specialties without a visible room, drug identities on unreadable packaging and scanner modality remain in the hospital word index.

visualRegions.description: Complete bright hospital atrium linking emergency, pathology, radiology, pharmacy and operating theatre
Emergency treatment bay with reception counter, bed, privacy curtain and monitors at the far left of the hospital atrium
Glass-fronted laboratory with two microscopes and racks of tubes, left of the imaging room.
Blue-lit imaging room containing a ring-shaped scanner, a patient table and a wheeled console.
Bore and upper-right housing of the blue-room scanner
Pharmacy dispensary with dense medication shelves, counter, storage drawers and rolling cart on the right
Blue operating theatre with suspended surgical lights, a draped table and a wall-side monitor.

detailZones.title: Emergency department
detailZones.description: The reception counter, wheeled bed, curtain and monitors in the red bay.

detailZones.title: Pathology laboratory
detailZones.description: Two microscopes sit behind glass above racks of red- and blue-capped tubes.

detailZones.title: Radiology suite
detailZones.description: A round scanner and patient table share the imaging room with a monitor and wheeled equipment.

detailZones.title: Hospital pharmacy
detailZones.description: A dispensing counter fronts stocked shelves, a work surface and a small metal trolley.

detailZones.title: Operating theatre
detailZones.description: Three suspended surgical lights hang above a draped operating table, with a monitor and glass door.

detailZones.title: Wayfinding signs and windows
detailZones.description: Colored overhead signs mark the rooms with a circle, hexagon, triangle, square and diamond.

detailZones.title: Atrium and waiting area
detailZones.description: Follow the floor from the foreground seating and planters to the departmental entrances.
